content.title: What is the NBA Play-In Tournament? Explaining 2026 matchups, rules, more
content.text: The NBA playoff spots are all set. With the 2025-26 regular season now in the books, 12 teams earned some much-needed rest before the grind of the playoffs. However, eight teams entered with a chance at the final two playoff spots in each conference. That set the stage for the league's Play-In Tournament, which over the last few years has added more intrigue and drama to those seeking a playoff berth. So, what is the tournament and which teams competed this season? Here's everything to know: MORE NBA COVERAGE What is the NBA Play-In Tournament? The Play-In Tournament helps establish the Nos. 7 and 8 seeds in each conference through a mini competition after the regular season. It was started by commissioner Adam Silver in 2020 and has become a mainstay in the league calendar since. 1:17Launching Legends NBA How does the NBA Play-In Tournament work? The tournament involves teams seeded 7-10 in each conference at the end of the regular season. Teams No. 7 and 8 will compete in one game while teams No. 9 and 10 also face off. The winner of the No. 7 vs. No. 8 game will earn the seventh seed, while the loser must battle the winner of the No. 9 vs. No. 10 game for the eighth seed. So, if a team ended the regular season in the No. 7 spot, losing both Play-In games would take that team of playoff contention despite the superior record across 82 regular-season games. When is the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament? The 2026 edition ran from Tuesday, April 14, to Friday, April 17. The playoffs begin on Saturday, April 18. Which teams are in the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament? Here's a look at the teams involved and their record before the tournament: EASTERN CONFERENCE No. 7 Philadelphia 76ers (45-37) No. 8 Orlando Magic (45-37) No. 9 Charlotte Hornets (44-38) No. 10 Miami Heat (43-39) WESTERN CONFERENCE No. 7 Phoenix Suns (45-37) No. 8 Portland Trail Blazers (42-40) No. 9 Los Angeles Clippers (42-40) No. 10 Golden State Warriors (37-45) What is the 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament schedule?
